![Cross-section of the IHP SG13CMOS5L technology (not to scale): four thin metal layers (Metal1 to Metal4) for dense routing and one 2 µm thick top metal layer (TopMetal1) for power routing, inductors, and bond pads, covered by the oxide/nitride passivation. The FEOL devices are shown at the bottom, and the numbers give the layer and dielectric thicknesses. Source: Fig. 1.1 of the *SG13CMOS5L Process Specification Rev. 0.2*, Copyright 2024 IHP PDK Authors, licensed under Apache-2.0, taken from [IHP-Open-PDK](https://github.com/IHP-GmbH/IHP-Open-PDK) and cropped out of the original page.](/content/technology/figures/ihp-sg13cmos5l-cross-section.png){#fig-metal-stack}
